summary: Six Flags Entertainment filed an 8-K regarding a Cooperation Agreement with significant investor H Partners Management. The agreement provides for the appointment of H Partners Founder Rehan Jaffer to the Board following the 2026 Annual Meeting, replacing departing director Arik Ruchim. No financial terms, share prices, or premiums are disclosed. The board approved the appointment and resignation. The agreement includes a standstill provision and a 3% minimum ownership requirement for Jaffer's continued board service. Investors should monitor for any future activist actions or strategic shifts by H Partners.
